{{Quote|It's always there, and easy to touch, and it wants us to use it for everything.|Blaise, summarising his views on the Force|<ref name="CD" />}}
'''Blaise''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served the [[Believers]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-worshipping [[Sith cult|cult]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], Blaise was among a team of Believers who stole a [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] box on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] believed contained a [[Pulas|powerful Sith artifact]]. While fleeing with their prize, the Believers' [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] crashed in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant undercity]] and Blaise was grievously injured.

==Biography==
Blaise was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He served the [[Believers]],<ref name="CD" /> a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-worshipping<ref name="BOTB">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref> [[Sith cult|cult]] that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], and became [[Brainwashing|brainwashed]] into supporting the ideology of the sect.<ref name="CD" /> Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is placed in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Therefore, the events of ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'' can be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> the Believers devised to steal the [[Pulas]], a powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], which was being transported to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Blaise joined a team of Believers who set out to steal the artifact when it arrived on the world, being brought along on the mission for his technical skills. The [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] ambushed a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on a Coruscant [[Hangar/Legends|landing platform]] that they believed was shipping the Pulas, shooting the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nysis Belzara]] and incapacitating the vessel's crew, though Blaise himself took no part in the attack. Blaise and the other Believers then seized a [[Beskar/Legends|Mandalorian iron]] box that they thought contained the Pulas, though which was actually a decoy planted by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], and fled the scene in a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]].<ref name="CD" />

The cultists sought to take the stolen box to a [[Coruscant Believers base|secret base]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant undercity]]. However, the Believers were tracked by a [[Heroes of Cularin|group of spacers]] who were assisting the Jedi with the transportation of the Pulas and a speeder chase ensued. The pursuit ended when the Believers' speeder crashed into a building in the Coruscant [[City/Legends|undercity]]. Blaise survived the impact and was thrown to one side severely injured, being left struggling to breath and with a face covered by burns. The other cultists abandoned Blaise at the crash site and ran off.<ref name="CD" />

{{RPG|''[[Coruscani Dawn]]''}}
The Jedi-allied [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] arrived at the wrecked speeder and provided Blaise basic medical treatment to stabilize his condition. After some persuasion, the cultist disclosed to the agents information on the location of the secret base to which the Believers were taking the stolen [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Iron/Legends|iron]] box.<ref name="CD" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Blaise was brainwashed during his time with the Believers and came to support the cult's doctrines that the Force,<ref name="CD" /> an energy field that bound the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] together,<ref name="Core Rulebook">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref> was something that could be used however one wish. He also viewed all beings who were not part of the cult as gravely evil and as a result he did not expect any non-Believers to come to his aid when he was injured a speeder crash on Coruscant. Despite his commitment to the cause of the Believers, Blaise was innocent and non-violent at heart.<ref name="CD" />

==Equipment==
During the mission to steal the Pulas, Blaise wore a [[Color/Legends|black]] [[jumpsuit]] and carried a [[Security kit/Legends|deluxe security kit]], for which he lacked a permit.<ref name="CD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Blaise was created by [[Morrie Mullins]] and appeared in ''[[Coruscani Dawn]]'', a [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure that formed part of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign. In ''Coruscani Dawn'', the players roleplay as the spacers who pursue the Believers through the Coruscant undercity and it is possible for the player characters to provide medical assistance to Blaise. If they restore him to consciousness then the player characters can coerce him, either through persuasion or a Jedi [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]], into providing details of the location of the Believers' hideout in the Coruscant undercity. If taken [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by the spacers, Blaise refuses to accompany them away from the speeder wreckage but does assent to being tied up and left in the spacers' own vehicle. If the players do not intervene to stabilize Blaise's condition the cultist [[Death/Legends|dies]] at the crash site from his injuries sustained in the collision.<ref name="CD" />
